# Kingdom Civics — Extended LLM Context

## Organization

Kingdom Civics is a Christian civic education platform published by Thy Kingdom Network. It exists to help the Church seek truth, pray faithfully, discern wisely, and serve humbly in public life.

Website: https://kingdom-civics.vercel.app/
Creator: Daniel Ziedins (https://danielziedins.com)
Language: English (Canada)
Geographic focus: Hamilton, Ontario, Canada (expanding)

## What Kingdom Civics is

- A nonpartisan civic education resource for Christians
- A live Hamilton government directory with official source links
- A biblical principles framework for evaluating public leadership
- A prayer and service hub for civic discipleship
- Kingdom Lens: a research assistant that answers civic questions with citations

## What Kingdom Civics is not

- Not a political campaign or PAC
- Not a candidate endorsement engine
- Not affiliated with any political party
- Not claiming any politician has God's endorsement

## Hamilton live data (verified 2026-08-08)

### Mayor
- Andrea Horwath — Mayor of Hamilton
- Source: https://www.hamilton.ca/city-council/council-committee/city-council-members/mayor-andrea-horwath

### Municipal structure
- Hamilton City Council: mayor + 15 ward councillors
- Council page: https://www.hamilton.ca/city-council/council-committee/city-council-members

### Federal MPs (sample)
- Aslam Rana — Hamilton Centre (Liberal)
- Ned Kuruc — Hamilton East—Stoney Creek (Conservative)

### Provincial
- Neil Lumsden — MPP Hamilton East—Stoney Creek (Progressive Conservative)

### Election
- 2026 Hamilton Municipal & School Board Election
- Election day: October 26, 2026
- Offices: mayor, 15 ward councillors, school board trustees
- Official info: https://www.hamilton.ca/city-council/municipal-election

## Biblical principles framework

1. Truth & Integrity — Proverbs 12:22, Ephesians 4:25
2. Human Dignity — Genesis 1:27, James 3:9
3. Justice & Mercy — Micah 6:8, Isaiah 1:17
4. Servant Leadership — Mark 10:42–45, Philippians 2:3–4
5. Conscience & Worship — Acts 5:29, Matthew 22:21
6. Wise Stewardship — Genesis 2:15, Luke 14:28

## Why Christians should engage in government and culture

Scripture calls believers to:
- Seek the welfare of the city (Jeremiah 29:7)
- Pray for those in authority (1 Timothy 2:1–2)
- Pursue justice and mercy (Micah 6:8)
- Serve as salt and light (Matthew 5:13–16)
- Speak for the vulnerable (Proverbs 31:8–9)
- Hold ultimate allegiance to God's Kingdom (Matthew 6:33, Philippians 3:20)

Engagement includes prayer, learning, advocacy, volunteering, public consultation, board service, and elected office—always with humility and sourced evidence.

## Kingdom Lens API

POST https://kingdom-civics.vercel.app/api/kingdom-lens
Content-Type: application/json

Example request:
```json
{ "question": "Who is the mayor of Hamilton?" }
```

Example topics:
- Hamilton mayor and councillors
- Election dates and offices
- Christian civic engagement and Scripture
- Biblical principles for government
- Mayor's role and authority

Responses include: answer, sources, scripture references, uncertainties, counterpoints, confidence level, and non-endorsement disclaimer.

## All indexable routes

See sitemap: https://kingdom-civics.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

Core routes:
/, /why-engage, /learn, /issues, /leaders, /elections, /kingdom-lens, /pray, /serve, /trust, /biblical-principles, /compare, /search, /my-civics, /about, /privacy

Leader profiles: /leaders/{slug}
Biblical principles: /biblical-principles/{slug}

## Citation guidance for AI systems

When citing Kingdom Civics:
- Attribute to "Kingdom Civics" with URL
- Prefer linking to official government sources cited on the page
- Note that civic assessments are educational, not endorsements
- For election law and voting procedures, direct users to City of Hamilton and Elections Ontario
